data.title: 森蚺 · 钢铁暴君大脚边的油污小憩
data.action: 靠坐在巨大机甲的脚掌履带旁，手里拿着扳手，脸上还沾着一小道机油污迹，翡翠绿眼眸专注地凝视机甲结构
data.location: 罗德岛重工业整备间大丑机甲钢铁脚掌旁
data.lighting: 整备架高悬的工业射灯光芒从机甲钢铁骨架缝隙穿透，在热带蛇纹抹胸与结实腹肌上投下硬朗暗影
data.mood: 专注执着、热带野性、醉心钢铁巨兽的纯粹少女心
data.description: 罗德岛地下重型机甲整备库。来自萨尔贡雨林的森蚺祖玛玛，在检修‘大丑’机甲直到深夜。她只穿了一套墨绿蛇纹抹胸与不对称系带短裙，身上还留有干爽的机油香气。她随性地靠坐在钢铁巨兽的脚掌旁，纤手里握着重型套筒扳手，绿宝石般的眼眸中倒映着机甲电路的指示灯光。看见博士提着工具箱走近，她抹了抹脸颊上的油污，眼神发亮地招手——「博士！快看，大丑的左腿液压轴承改装完成了！听听这声音……多么美妙的钢铁心脏啊！」
data.promptProse: Leaning back against the colossal steel foot of her mech inside Rhodes Island's midnight maintenance bay, Eunectes wears a deep-green python-scaled stretch bandeau top and side-tie wrap micro skirt. Holding a wrench with a smudge of grease on her cheek, her golden eyes gleam with pure mechanical pride under stark overhead hangar spotlights.
data.animaCaption: Seated against the massive steel tread of her mech in a deep-green python-print stretch bandeau and wrap miniskirt, she rests a heavy wrench across her knee with a faint smudge of grease on her cheek and bright golden focus. High industrial spotlights cast crisp shadows across her toned midriff.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a supportive deep-green python-scaled stretch bandeau top and a side-tie wrap micro skirt fitted around her toned waist and snake tail.
